questions.question: Check the anniversary of *Arithmetic*: for the 1703 first edition, the 2023 article marks 320 years.

localizations.source: Check the anniversary of *Arithmetic*: for the 1703 first edition, the 2023 article marks 320 years.
localizations.ru: Сверить юбилейную дату «Арифметики»: для первого издания 1703 года материал 2023 года отмечает 320-летие.

questions.resolution: Corrected 220 years to 320 years in both editions.

questions.question: Clarify biographical traditions about Magnitsky’s surname and education, and the claim about mathematical terminology.

localizations.source: Clarify biographical traditions about Magnitsky’s surname and education, and the claim about mathematical terminology.
localizations.ru: Уточнить биографические предания о фамилии и обучении Магницкого, а также формулировку о математической терминологии.

questions.resolution: Disputed details are identified as biographical tradition or as disputed; the absolute priority claim was replaced by a verifiable statement about usage and establishment in *Arithmetic*.

questions.question: Provide a verifiable source for the relief portrait of Magnitsky, identify the sculptor and photographer or the responsible institution, and document the licence or other confirmed basis for reproduction; keep the attribution synchronized in RU and EN.

localizations.source: Provide a verifiable source for the relief portrait of Magnitsky, identify the sculptor and photographer or the responsible institution, and document the licence or other confirmed basis for reproduction; keep the attribution synchronized in RU and EN.
localizations.ru: Укажите проверяемый источник рельефного портрета Магницкого, автора рельефа и фотографии либо учреждение-правообладателя, а также лицензию или иное подтверждённое основание воспроизведения; синхронизируйте атрибуцию в RU/EN.
